`same_as_username`, `same_as_current`).

AccessKind.title: AccessKind
AccessKind.description:
Content or management (design-doc §3.1, §5): how each action is marked, and what an
inherited admin keeps on an export-controlled project without an explicit membership.

AccessReason.title: AccessReason
AccessReason.description: Why someone reaches an org or a project (design-doc §5, "Access review"; DL-72).

AccessReview.title: AccessReview
AccessReview.description:
The per-person access review (design-doc §5): every org and project the person reaches,
and why. Orgs sorted by name, projects by key.

Action.title: Action
Action.description: The real actions (DL-44, DL-45, DL-56; each area adds its own).

EmailCheck.title: EmailCheck
EmailCheck.description: Whether an account has this email; never whose (DL-66).

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description:
The body of every error response. `details` depends on `code` (e.g. `fields` for
`validation_error`).

HealthRead.title: HealthRead
HealthRead.description:
A healthy response. When the database is unreachable the endpoint returns 503 with the
standard error body instead (`service_unavailable`).

MeOrg.title: MeOrg
MeOrg.description:
An org the user sees (design-doc §4, "Visibility"), for the org menu. `role` is null
when the user sees it without an org membership (through a project, or as an admin above
it).

MeRead.title: MeRead
MeRead.description: The signed-in user: `GET /api/auth/me`, and the sign-in response.

MeWorkspace.title: MeWorkspace
MeWorkspace.description:
A workspace the user is staff of, or, for a system admin, any workspace (`role` null where
they aren't staff; DL-46), with the workspace-level actions they may take there (DL-45).

MemberAdd.title: MemberAdd
MemberAdd.description: Add an existing account, found by email (design-doc §4: the email comes first).

MemberCandidate.title: MemberCandidate
MemberCandidate.description: Someone the picker offers: an org member or staff member not yet on the project.

MemberRead.title: MemberRead
MemberRead.description: An org member, with the actions the caller may take on this row.

MemberRoleUpdate.title: MemberRoleUpdate
MemberRoleUpdate.description:
`new_owner_id`: when an owner steps down, a current member to make owner in the same
change (the last owner needs one; DL-59).

ModuleGuidance.title: ModuleGuidance
ModuleGuidance.description: Static guidance for module choice (design-doc §1.1; DL-76).

MyWork.title: MyWork
MyWork.description: `GET /api/me/work` (design-doc §11; DL-76): every section in one response.

NewUser.title: NewUser
NewUser.description:
A new account: the admin passes on the temporary password, which the user must change
at their first sign-in.

OrgCreate.title: OrgCreate
OrgCreate.description:
An org and its first owner: exactly one of `owner_id` (an existing active user) and
`new_owner` (a new account).

OwnProfileUpdate.title: OwnProfileUpdate
OwnProfileUpdate.description:
The signed-in user's change to their own profile: their email isn't theirs to change in v1
(design-doc §4).

PasswordPolicyRead.title: PasswordPolicyRead
PasswordPolicyRead.description:
`GET /api/auth/password-policy` (DL-91): the requirements, in order. The length cap isn't
listed; the server refuses it.

PasswordRequirement.title: PasswordRequirement
PasswordRequirement.description:
One requirement a new password must meet: `code` is the 422 field error `type` it prevents
(DL-94), `label` is written for users, and `value` is the number it needs, where it has one.

PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset
PasswordReset.description: The temporary password an admin sets; the user must change it at next sign-in.

ProjectAccessEntry.title: ProjectAccessEntry
ProjectAccessEntry.description: One person who reaches the project: their explicit role, if any, and why they reach it.

ProjectAccessReview.title: ProjectAccessReview
ProjectAccessReview.description:
The per-project access review (design-doc §5; DL-78): everyone who reaches the project,
sorted by name.

ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate
ProjectCreate.description: A new project in an org (DL-76). Without `enabled_modules`, it's seeded from the type.

ProjectItem.title: ProjectItem
ProjectItem.description: A project in a list: the org's projects, and My work's projects section.

ProjectMemberAdd.title: ProjectMemberAdd
ProjectMemberAdd.description:
Exactly one of `user_id` (from the picker) and `email` (email first, design-doc §4).
`join_org` confirms adding an account from outside the org and the staff to the org too
(DL-78).

ProjectMemberRead.title: ProjectMemberRead
ProjectMemberRead.description: An explicit project membership, with the actions the caller may take on this row.

ProjectModule.title: ProjectModule
ProjectModule.description:
Modules a project may enable. Only shipped-or-v1 modules are allowed values; each v2
module is added (with the `enabled_modules` CHECK) when it ships (schema-doc, `project`).

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; `lead_id: null` clears the lead. The key never changes.

RestrictionUpdate.title: RestrictionUpdate
RestrictionUpdate.description:
`PUT /api/projects/{key}/restriction` (DL-81): `level` (null: None) and
`categories` replace the current ones. Adding `export_controlled` also needs
`export_control_confirmed` and `confirmed_member_ids`, the project's current explicit
members.

SlugAvailability.title: SlugAvailability
SlugAvailability.description:
Whether a slug can be used: `problem` is the slug rule's problem (`reserved`,
`too_short`, ...), or `taken`; null when it's available.

StaffAdd.title: StaffAdd
StaffAdd.description: Add an existing account, found by email (design-doc §4: the email comes first).

StaffRead.title: StaffRead
StaffRead.description: A workspace staff member, with the actions the caller may take on this row.

StaffRoleUpdate.title: StaffRoleUpdate
StaffRoleUpdate.description:
`new_owner_id`: when an owner steps down, current staff to make owner in the same change
(the last owner needs one; DL-59).

UserRow.title: UserRow
UserRow.description:
A user as the workspace users list shows them (DL-72), with the account actions the caller
may take on them.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: An admin's change to a user's profile: any subset of the three (DL-72).

UsernameSuggestion.title: UsernameSuggestion
UsernameSuggestion.description: An available username suggested from a name, or null when none can be made (DL-66).

ReservedSlug.title: ReservedSlug
ReservedSlug.description: Top-level browser routes: no workspace or org slug may be one.
